tokenName: Investment Bank Agri Warehouse Receipt Token
description: Investment Bank aggregates warehouse receipts from rural cooperatives and smallholder storage facilities across Canada and structures them into investable digital tokens. Farmer groups receive immediate liquidity against stored produce while investors gain commodity-backed income. Reduces post-harvest losses and creates stable farmgate employment.
regulatoryFramework: Canada Financial Markets Act; Canada Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Informal Services Contract Token
description: Investment Bank structures pools of verified gig and informal economy contracts in Canada into investable instruments. Plumbers, electricians, caterers, security guards and cleaning service providers receive DID-verified digital contracts, enabling them to access advance payment against future earnings. Reduces the financial vulnerability of informal workers.
regulatoryFramework: Canada Financial Markets Act; Canada Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Community Infrastructure PPP Token
description: Investment Bank structures public-private partnership infrastructure projects with mandatory local employment clauses in Canada. regulatoryFramework: Canada Financial Markets Act; Canada Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024
